svg.title: Read, change, and check again
svg.desc: Research design proposed by this review. Find a behavior, test an internal hypothesis on new inputs, intervene on units or circuits, and reassess both the target behavior and ordinary capabilities. Tracking specific trait signals has already been reported. Sustained deployment audits that measure false alarms and missed cases across model and context changes remain a further task. Readable explanations and successful edits do not establish safety. Arrows show test order, not computational connections inside a network.
